meta.name: multi-reviewer-patterns
meta.description: Coordinate parallel code reviews across multiple quality dimensions with finding deduplication, severity calibration, and consolidated reporting. Use this skill when organizing multi-reviewer code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

copy.tagline: 协调多路并行代码审查，去重并汇总结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常组织多人代码审查并需统一汇总反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel code reviews, deduplicate findings, and consolidate results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often organize code review with multiple reviewers and need consolidated feedback.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按多个质量维度组织并行代码评审:给各评审者分配审查维度、合并重复发现、统一严重度分级,并产出一份带问题统计表的汇总报告。
howto.when: 当你组织多维度代码评审、校准问题严重度,或汇总多个评审结果时接管。

say.text: 帮我给这个 PR 安排一次多维度代码评审
say.note: 会分配安全、性能等维度并汇总成报告

say.text: 把两个评审者对同一行报的问题合并一下
say.note: 同位置同类问题合并,保留更高严重度

say.text: 按标准重新给这条发现定严重度
say.note: 按影响与可能性归入 Critical 到 Low

howto.what_en: After install, Claude organizes parallel code reviews across quality dimensions: assigning review dimensions, deduplicating findings from multiple reviewers, calibrating severity, and producing one consolidated report.
howto.when_en: Use when organizing multi-dimensional code reviews, calibrating finding severity, or consolidating review results.

say_en.text: Set up a multi-dimension review for this PR
Merge the findings two reviewers reported on the same line
say_en.note: Same-location issues merge, keeping the higher severity

say_en.text: Re-rate this finding's severity against the criteria
say_en.note: Maps it to Critical through Low by impact and likelihood
